title: Rick Steves Travel the World VHS Lot of 3 Ireland Great Britain Italy SEALED
descriptionText:
Ireland Great Britain Italy NEW Sealed

Description

Vintage Travel the World with Rick Steves VHS collection. Lot includes 3 travel programs:

* Ireland — Western Ireland, Dublin & Belfast
* Great Britain — London & Edinburgh
* Italy — Venice & Florence

Hosted by Rick Steves and originally produced from the Travels in Europe with Rick Steves television/video series.

All three VHS tapes appear new and factory sealed in their original shrink wrap. The outer packaging has some light storage/age wear and minor marks visible through/on the shrink wrap. Please review all photos for exact condition.

You will receive the exact three VHS tapes pictured.

NTSC / VHS / English
